correctness.rationale: The binary transfer matrices follow directly from the recurrence. Four explicitly named palindromes at every length >=8 have verified Stern values ell, 4ell-12, 9ell-42, and 16ell-104; their gcd is gcd(ell,2). Modulo 2, the Stern sequence vanishes precisely on multiples of 3, while even-length binary palindromes are multiples of 3, giving the matching lower bound. Exact full short-length enumeration covers ell=1..7. Reproducible independent bit-transfer enumeration checks all 4094 palindromic indices at ell=1..22 and symbolic coefficients, but infinite proof rests on matrices/parity. No extrapolation or unverified lemma is needed.

value.rationale: Uniform classification of exact shared prime obstructions on a natural digit-defined family with exponentially many indices is a substantive arithmetic invariant of Stern’s classical recurrence. The isolated length-six exception and explicit four-template universal witnesses give structural information not implied by finite enumeration. The claim neither invents an arbitrary numerical cutoff nor requires downstream application; it is a complete motivated classification.
